userDecisions.parityScope: 1:1 replica of the removed floater's panel INTERIOR — panelHead (title + busy dot + collapse control), the `teams` scroll body, the adopted emptyHint/empty text, archivedWrap/archiveLabel, every adopted CSS-module class. whatChanged.AgentTeams page (packages/mpd-bundle-plu: Renders the adopted panel's interior instead of a bespoke inline-styled wrapper: an `aside` root carrying the adopted `panel` class — which is what scopes the `--dsw-alias-*` custom properties every adopted team/member/task rule reads, so without it the sections render unstyled — a `panelHead` with `panelTitle` + `data-busy` `panelDot` + a `panelControls`/`iconButton` collapse control using the platform's own IconChevronDownOutline14, the `teams` scroll body, the adopted `emptyHint` carrying the adopted `activity.empty` text, and the original archived markup. Window-manager half overridden inline (PANE_STYLE) and `data-compact` set so the head does not advertise a drag. The collapse control closes the sidebar panel through `store.reduce(state => ({...state, panelOpen: false}))` — the same next-state shape as the sidebar's own togglePanel. The dead `loaded` store flag was removed.
whatChanged.Workmate page (packages/mpd-bundle-plugi: The `shell.overlay` floater (WorkmatePanel), the `sidebar.footer.action` toggle (WorkmateToggle), their shared `workmateOpen` state, the `mpd:workmate:toggle` window event and the now-unused dictionary keys were deleted. `apply()` registers the sidebar tab unconditionally and warns once when the sidebar is absent.

limits: No browser click-through and no screenshot comparison: the acceptance contract the user approved is offline (harness + dsh-qa evidence). Visual parity is pinned structurally — every adopted class name, the adopted locale strings, the platform icon component, the dropped window-manager properties, and a real-React render of the real adopted views — rather than pixel-diffed. The user confirms visually after a page refresh.

The historic-card branch of the adopted panel stays unreachable by construction (its registry came from the removed in-conversation card) and is therefore not rendered; `historicCardTeam` remains bridged for parity.

The panel head's dock/float control is NOT reproduced: it is window-manager machinery with no sidebar counterpart, which the approved scope covers ('interior only'). The collapse control IS reproduced and drives the sidebar's panel state.
The adopted panel head has no member-count element (that lives on the removed card header); none was invented, so the head matches the original exactly.

The real-render harness stubs @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives (the package is ESM and imports katex CSS, which Node cannot load) and shims useSyncExternalStore/useEffect for SSR; the page itself does not depend on either shim.
